coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Macapá’s public SIT dynamically configures an “Identificar Lote Físico” ArcGIS polygon layer with idlote as its key.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Nearby source-native public polygons are verified. The existing adapter completed 9/13 bounded cells (161 distinct IDs); it held cells 0, 1, 4 and 9 because each manifest contains duplicate idlote OIDs. Raw full-geometry responses show all repeated IDs in those cells have identical polygon hashes. Exact WUP point returned zero, which is informational and not a source gate. Citywide completeness and production stability remain unverified.

technicalBlocker: Existing ArcGIS adapter holds four of the 13 bounded cells because the anonymous layer's returnIdsOnly manifest repeats its only exposed OID, idlote. Full native polygons for all 15 repeated-ID groups are identical within each ID, but layer metadata exposes no GlobalID or separate unique row identifier; offset mode also rejects the repeated IDs. This adapter identity-contract failure is the runtime hold.
remainingUncertainty: The other nine bounded cells returned complete features (161 distinct idlote values); their exact-ID full-geometry re-reads, forced page-size-1 test, synthetic absence, nearby footprint read, proposal binding, and corrected topology checks passed. Four cells remain held solely on repeated OID manifests despite identical full polygon geometry for every repeated ID. The unchanged WUP-point query returned zero and a nearby lot is about 16 m from the point; that locator miss is informational, not a runtime gate. The official municipal SIT config directly names this layer, while its upstream hostname includes hml; host/production stability is also informational and unverified. Citywide completeness and title/ownership scope remain unknown.
nextStep: Keep runtime disabled until the municipal service exposes a unique feature-row OID/ID or corrects the view so each idlote is unique per returned feature; then re-run the existing adapter qualification. Root may independently review the positive nearby geometry finding. The WUP-point miss and hml hostname do not gate the source.
